          Company Introduction

          Get to Know OLIVE YOUNG

          Olive Young is a Korean health and beauty platform with over 1,400 offline stores nationwide.

          While we currently do not operate brick-and-mortar stores internationally,
          the Olive Young Global Mall aims to bring you the same authentic products available in our Korean stores.
          Experience the quality and excellence of Olive Young, now accessible worldwide!

          All orders from Olive Young Global Mall are shipped directly from Korea.

          Olive Young provides shipping services to over 60 countries worldwide,
          ensuring safe and fast delivery through trusted courier services such as DHL, FedEx, LX Pantos and EMS.
